book.title: The Void Awakens
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: The Glitch in the Grind
chapters.goal: Survive the initial Void-breach during a routine tutorial dungeon.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a predictable level-grind to an existential system collapse where death is permanent.

bridge.to_next: Kaelen escapes the collapsing dungeon with a corrupted UI and a unique 'Void-Touched' status.

chapters.title: Error 404: Reality Not Found
chapters.goal: Identify the unique properties and exploits of the new Void-Touched class.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a confused survivor to the possessor of a dangerous, system-breaking exploit.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen is safe but his character sheet is a mess of purple text and errors.
bridge.to_next: The realization that the Void isn't just a glitch, but a resource he can harvest.

chapters.title: The Tutorial is Over
chapters.goal: Escape the instanced starter zone before the System's 'Clean-Up' protocol deletes it.
chapters.stakes_shift: From exploring a new power to a desperate race against literal deletion.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen masters his first Void skill just as the sky begins to pixelate and dissolve.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen breaks through the instance barrier into the wider, equally chaotic world.

chapters.title: Welcome to the New Normal
chapters.goal: Reach the hub city of Oakhaven and assess the scale of the global System failure.
chapters.stakes_shift: From an isolated incident to the realization that the entire world's physics are failing.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen arrives at the city gates to find the guards fighting invisible, 'null' entities.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen discovers that other 'glitched' players are being hunted by the System's automated enforcers.

chapters.title: The Black Market of Mana
chapters.goal: Acquire a Void-stabilizer from the city's underworld to prevent his own mana-implosion.
chapters.stakes_shift: From having an unstable power to possessing a controlled, illegal weapon.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen's Void levels become critical, threatening to turn him into a Rift.
bridge.to_next: With his power stabilized, Kaelen learns of a 'Void Shard' hidden in a nearby high-level zone.

chapters.title: Deep Dive into the Dark
chapters.goal: Clear the Sunken Crypt to retrieve the first Void Shard and upgrade his core stats.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a local anomaly to a significant threat to the System's remaining balance.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen enters the crypt, realizing the monsters inside have evolved using the Void.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen absorbs the Shard, triggering a global System announcement that names him a 'Primary Threat'.

chapters.title: The Architect's Lie
chapters.goal: Decode the hidden developer logs within the Shard to find the truth about the Void.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a loyal System user to a rebel who knows the System was designed to fail.

bridge.from_prev: The Shard reveals that the 'Void' is actually the original state of the world.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen realizes he needs an ally who understands the old world's code.

chapters.title: Two Wrongs Make a Right
chapters.goal: Form an uneasy alliance with Lyra, an exiled Sentinel who was framed by the System.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a solo survivor to the leader of a burgeoning fringe movement.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen saves Lyra from a System 'Purge' squad.
bridge.to_next: Lyra agrees to lead Kaelen to the Rift Core, but only if they save her village first.

chapters.title: The First Surge
chapters.goal: Defend Oakhaven from a massive Void-surge that threatens to overwrite the city.
chapters.stakes_shift: From personal survival to becoming the reluctant protector of thousands of innocents.

bridge.from_prev: The sky turns purple as the first true Void-storm hits the city walls.
bridge.to_next: The city is saved, but the System marks Kaelen for immediate 'Hard Deletion'.

chapters.title: The Purge Protocol
chapters.goal: Evade and defeat the 'Anti-Virus' enforcers sent to scrub Kaelen from the world.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a hunted anomaly to actively hunting the System's own agents.

bridge.from_prev: The System deploys a Level 99 'Inquisitor' to handle the glitch.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen uses a Void-exploit to defeat the Inquisitor, gaining administrative access.

chapters.title: Awakening the Void
chapters.goal: Reach the core of the Rift and decide whether to patch the world or let it burn.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a fugitive to the potential master of a new, unscripted world order.

bridge.from_prev: Kaelen and Lyra fight their way to the center of the world's source code.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen shatters the final System constraint, fully awakening the Void.

chapters.title: Patch Notes for the Apocalypse
chapters.goal: Establish a new base of operations and prepare for the inevitable System reboot attempt.
chapters.stakes_shift: From ending the immediate threat to beginning a long-term revolution against the Architects.

bridge.from_prev: The old System is dead; the world is now a lawless, Void-infused sandbox.
bridge.to_next: Kaelen looks at his new UI: 'Quest Started: Rebuild Reality'.
